excerpt: How renovating on Long Island differs from NYC in code requirements, permit processes, and costs.
body:
The Romex Difference

NYC requires EMT conduit for all wiring. Long Island allows Romex. Practical impact: electrical work on Long Island costs 20-40% less.

Permits: Borough vs. Town

NYC: all permits through DOB. Long Island: individual town building departments. Nassau has 3 main towns plus cities and villages. Suffolk has 10 towns. Requirements vary by municipality.

Cost Comparison

Long Island renovations are 10-20% less than comparable NYC projects. Savings from Romex, easier logistics, and lower overhead. Material and cabinet costs are identical.
